gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-imprima: Imprima is a plain sans with a smooth, tube-like line and terminals that flare outward at the ends. And Bruno Ace SC is the showier one, spreading its open letters out like beads on a thread while Imprima just keeps the text going.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-inclusive-sans: Inclusive Sans has round letters whose rims match the stems, and every curve ends in an open finish. Inclusive Sans keeps the text grounded while Bruno Ace SC, wide and distinctive, takes the spotlight above it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-istok-web: Istok Web is a modern sans with rounded letters and a clearly open side. But Bruno Ace SC looks drawn in neon tube, every stroke the same, which makes the softer body text feel even friendlier.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-jost: Jost is a clean sans-serif with broad gaps at the terminals and a unit-width stroke throughout. Jost gives Bruno Ace SC, with its beads-on-a-thread spacing, a tidy partner that lets the wide display letters stand out.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-jura: Neutral and clean, with strokes as constant as bent wire and s curves that open wide at both ends. Jura handles the steady reading while Bruno Ace SC, spaced out like beads on a thread, handles the attention-grabbing.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-k2d: K2D reads clean, a plain sans with c terminals hanging far from the bowl. Its tube-like thickness holds through every bend, so it sits comfortably under the widely spaced, open-mouthed letters of Bruno Ace SC.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-kanchenjunga: Kanchenjunga has the steady line of a technical drafting pen, with shapes that never clog at low resolution. And Bruno Ace SC is the expressive one, spreading its open letters wide while Kanchenjunga does the quiet precise work.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-kantumruy-pro: Kantumruy Pro is an approachable sans-serif with an e whose eye opens clearly to the right, and no hairlines or swells anywhere. Bruno Ace SC spreads out loudly above it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-kodchasan: Kodchasan reads clean and neutral, its terminals hanging open with no calligraphic thinning. Kodchasan shares that trait with Bruno Ace SC, so the sans-serif body feels like a quieter relative of the beaded, wide-set heading.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-koho: Expressive is the word for Bruno Ace SC. Its strokes carry the same visual weight everywhere and its letters spread wide, while KoHo, a neutral sans with wide c apertures, simply stays out of the way.
